title: Status Badge Tones
description: A dispatcher scanning the tracking table shouldn't have to read every word — the Badge color for each status should be legible at a glance, and consistent with what that color means everywhere else in SwiftCargo.
successCondition: On /tracking, a shipment with status "booked" renders its Badge with warning tone, "in_transit" renders teal tone, "delivered" renders success tone, and "cancelled" renders neutral tone — checked for at least one shipment of each of the four statuses.
hints: You may need to use the status filter dropdown and the dispatcher/admin "Advance" button to get at least one shipment into each of the four states.
statusTone() in TrackingDashboard.tsx is the exact mapping being tested — read it if you want to double-check expected tones before writing assertions.
